## 🛠 Context & Rationale

## 🎯 Objective

## ✅ Acceptance Criteria (AC)

- [ ] Code is successfully refactored without altering existing user behavior.
- [ ] `npm run type-check` and `npm run lint` pass perfectly.
- [ ] Automated tests pass (`npm test`).
- [ ] **Performance:** Is there a measurable improvement? (If applicable)

## ⚡ Impact Assessment

- [ ] **App Performance** (Faster renders, optimized API calls)
- [ ] **App Size** (Smaller bundle size)
- [ ] **Security** (Updated dependencies, tightened Firebase rules)
- [ ] **Developer Experience** (Faster CI builds, better Husky hooks)

## 🔗 Related Dependencies & PRs

## 🛡️ Triage Checklist (For Tech Lead)

- [ ] Priority assessed against user-facing features.
- [ ] Ticket assigned a `VOL-XXX` identifier.
